title: Show HN: A language model that lives in a boot sector
summary: A developer released a tiny language model on GitHub that runs from a computer's boot sector, with no operating system needed.
whyItMatters: It's a quirky demonstration of how small a working language model can be made.

title: Brazilian Court Sanctions Lawyers for Prompt Injection in Court Filing
summary: A Brazilian court sanctioned lawyers who embedded prompt injection in a court filing, apparently aimed at influencing AI tools reviewing it.
whyItMatters: It's an early legal consequence of prompt injection in real-world AI-assisted workflows.

title: 4 days left: How TechCrunch Founder Summit helps you make more useful connections to scale
snippet: On November 4 at Boston’s SoWa Power Station, get ready for a full day packed with meaningful networking opportunities, actionable insights, and connections that could change the trajectory of your idea and startup. Register before all prices go up at the door.

title: Anthropic takes steps to block Claude from reverse-engineering video games
summary: Anthropic is adding safeguards to stop Claude from being used to reverse-engineer video games.
whyItMatters: It shows Anthropic tightening usage restrictions on specific coding use cases, which may affect modders and security researchers.

title: The AI cost of JavaScript frameworks
summary: Nolan Lawson examines the cost of JavaScript frameworks in the era of AI coding tools, where models favor popular frameworks.
whyItMatters: It raises how AI assistants may entrench dominant frameworks and shape tech stack choices.

title: ChatGPT and Codex usage limits merging
summary: OpenAI is merging usage limits for ChatGPT and Codex into a single shared allowance.
whyItMatters: Heavy Codex users will draw from the same pool as ChatGPT usage, changing how they budget their plan.

title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
snippet: Apple's new CEO defended the company's current position in the AI landscape.
summary: Apple's new CEO defended the company's AI position, saying Apple doesn't want to ship AI for AI's sake.
whyItMatters: It signals Apple will keep a cautious, product-driven AI strategy rather than racing rivals on features.

title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
snippet: An NAACP lawsuit accuses the SpaceX-owned AI company of violating the Clean Air Act.
summary: A judge is allowing the NAACP's Clean Air Act lawsuit over pollution from xAI's data center to proceed. xAI is now owned by SpaceX.
whyItMatters: The case could set precedent for environmental liability around AI data centers' power generation.

title: Anthropic blocks users for anything touching training larger models
summary: Users report that Anthropic is blocking accounts for requests related to training larger models.
whyItMatters: Builders working on model training or distillation with Claude may hit enforcement of usage policies.
